headline_marked: 2 [[UPDF members killed in gunfire]] in Khagrachari
headline: 2 UPDF members killed in gunfire in Khagrachari
summary: One member was killed in a clash with security forces in Ramgarh, while another was shot dead in Dighinala, allegedly by JSS members.
details: Two members of the United People's Democratic Front (UPDF-Prasit) were killed in separate gunfire incidents in Khagrachari's Dighinala and Ramgarh unions on Wednesday.
In Ramgarh's Premtala area around 10 AM, a clash occurred between security forces and the UPDF. UPDF member Bobin Tripura, 32, was killed, and another member, Mongsanu Marma, was reportedly injured.
The UPDF spokesperson, Anggy Marma, claimed that security forces had laid an ambush and attacked their workers. Security forces recovered an AK-47 rifle from the scene.
Ramgarh Police Station OC Md. Nazir Alam confirmed the gunfire but stated that the body had not yet been handed over to the police due to the difficult terrain of the area.
Later that afternoon, UPDF member Sujan Chakma, 48, was shot dead in the Muropara area of Dighinala upazila while sitting in a shop.
The UPDF has blamed the Parbatya Chattagram Jana Samhiti (PJS) for the attack, claiming masked gunmen on motorcycles opened fire on Chakma.
Dighinala Police Station OC Iqbal Bahar confirmed that five masked individuals on motorcycles shot Chakma, leaving three bullet wounds on his body.
caption:
Two UPDF members killed in separate gunfire incidents in Khagrachari today.

Two members of the United People's Democratic Front (UPDF-Prasit) were killed in separate gunfire incidents in Khagrachari's Dighinala and Ramgarh unions on Wednesday.

In Ramgarh's Premtala area around 10 AM, a clash occurred between security forces and the UPDF. UPDF member Bobin Tripura, 32, was killed, and another member, Mongsanu Marma, was reportedly injured.

The UPDF spokesperson, Anggy Marma, claimed that security forces had laid an ambush and attacked their workers. Security forces recovered an AK-47 rifle from the scene.

Ramgarh Police Station OC Md. Nazir Alam confirmed the gunfire but stated that the body had not yet been handed over to the police due to the difficult terrain of the area.

Later that afternoon, UPDF member Sujan Chakma, 48, was shot dead in the Muropara area of Dighinala upazila while sitting in a shop.

The UPDF has blamed the Parbatya Chattagram Jana Samhiti (PJS) for the attack, claiming masked gunmen on motorcycles opened fire on Chakma.

Dighinala Police Station OC Iqbal Bahar confirmed that five masked individuals on motorcycles shot Chakma, leaving three bullet wounds on his body.

headline_marked: PM Tarique [[reaches Beijing via bullet train]] after Summer Davos summit
headline: PM Tarique reaches Beijing via bullet train after Summer Davos summit
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman arrives in the Chinese capital following his participation in the World Economic Forum's annual conference in Dalian.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has arrived in Beijing after traveling from Dalian via a high-speed bullet train on Wednesday.
The Prime Minister departed Dalian in Liaoning province at 2:00 PM local time and reached the capital at 5:35 PM.
Prior to his departure, he attended the annual 'Summer Davos' conference organized by the World Economic Forum (WEF) in Dalian at 10:00 AM.
The prestigious summit brought together over 1,700 representatives, including politicians, business leaders, academics, and media professionals from more than 90 countries and regions.
This visit is part of a three-day tour of China, which began on June 22 when the Prime Minister arrived in Dalian from Malaysia.
caption:
